decision_effect: Split R-AUTHZ-1's Cedar citation. (1) Evaluator / authorizer / validator / typechecker / TPE / slicing theorems: cite at A at cedar-spec v4.14.0 with gate log spikes/cedar-axioms/raw/audit.out (axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}). (2) SymCC theorems (compile_*, isAuthorized_is_sound/complete, verify*_is_sound/complete, used for the deploy-time cedar-policy-symcc 0.8 checks) stay at B: they depend on 10 native_decide axioms (Int64 and datetime constants). Replace ARCHITECTURE §3.5 text 'Int64 native_decide is in the TPE closure' with: 'native_decide is in the import closure of TPE but not in the axiom closure of any TPE, authorization or validation theorem; it is in the axiom closure of 84 theorems, all in Cedar/Thm/SymCC*, Verification, WellTypedVerification, SymbolicCompilation or the 7 root lemmas (10 axioms).' The CI gate must run the per-theorem axiom check (scripts/AxiomAudit.lean), not a module-level grep: a grep for native_decide over imported modules over-reports.
rung: measurement grade A for the axiom sets at the pinned tag (direct kernel-environment query, controls pass); executed on a LAN box (kamrui), not CI
reproduce: on kamrui: ~/aegis-ci/bin/cedar-build.sh (= scripts/build.sh); cd ~/aegis-ci/src/cedar-spec/cedar-lean && ELAN_HOME=~/aegis-ci/elan PATH=~/aegis-ci/elan/bin:$PATH MEM=8G ~/aegis-ci/bin/heavy lake env lean ~/aegis-ci/work/cedar-axioms/AxiomAudit.lean; controls: lean scripts/Control.lean
limits: Axioms are read from .olean files elaborated by the same Lean binary; no independent kernel re-check (lean4checker / `lake check --paranoid`) was run, so a Lean kernel or elaborator soundness bug (e.g. #14484/#14576/#15908 class) is not excluded. The theorems are about Cedar's Lean model; the Rust cedar-policy 4.14.0 is tied to it only by Cedar's DRT, so the claim wording stays 'verified Lean model + DRT-tested Rust evaluator'. Theorem selection for Part 1 is ours; Part 2 scans all theorems so no cited theorem can hide. The 7 native_decide root lemmas are trivial constant facts that `decide` should discharge (shown for one), so an upstream PR could move SymCC to A too; not attempted.
